sloka: ते वाहनान्यवस्थाप्य यानानि विविधानि च ।सभाम् पद्भिः प्रविविशुः सिम्हा गिरिगुहामिव ॥६-११-२३॥।।
transliteration: te vāhanānyavasthāpya yānāni vividhāni ca ।sabhām padbhiḥ praviviśuḥ simhā giriguhāmiva ॥6-11-23॥।।

translations.english: Parking those vehicles of several kinds at the entrance they entered the royal court by foot like the lions entering the cave of a mountain.
